test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

The teacher had praised the hardworking students.

options.text: The hardworking students had praised the teacher.
The hardworking students had been praised by the teacher.
The hardworking students were praised by the teacher.
The hardworking students have been praised by the teacher.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The teacher had praised the hardworking students."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the hardworking students" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had praised" to "had been praised" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the teacher."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The hardworking students had been praised by the teacher."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The hardworking students had praised the teacher." – This changes the subject and meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "The hardworking students were praised by the teacher." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of past perfect).
 
• **Option 4:** "The hardworking students have been praised by the teacher." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past perfect).
